context.stage: Stage 1 — verify provider fix; re-run full Stage 1 test suite

task.description:
After ISSUE-FIXER has fixed the provider errors (step-01), re-run the full Stage 1 test suite to confirm all tests still pass.

## Pre-flight

1. Confirm `zig build` exits 0.
2. Start the test database if not running:
   ```
   docker compose up -d db_test
   ```
3. Verify it is healthy:
   ```
   docker compose exec db_test pg_isready -U bpm
   ```
4. Apply migrations:
   ```
   BPM_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test zig build migrate
   ```

## Test runs

```
zig build test
BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test zig build test-integration
```

For each run record: exit code, passed, failed, skipped.

## Report

Write the verification report to `tests/reports/WF03-provider-20260521-verify-01.md`.

The report MUST include:
- Build result
- Pre-flight results
- Per-command results (command | exit code | passed | failed | skipped)
- Comparison to previous run (WF02-stage1-integration-20260520-run-01.md): same tests pass/fail?
- Verdict: PASS (all tests that passed before still pass) or FAIL

## Acceptance criteria
- `zig build` exits 0
- `zig build test` exits 0
- `zig build test-integration` exits 0 with no failures
- All 17 integration tests that passed in WF02-stage1-integration-20260520-run-01 still pass
- Report written to tests/reports/WF03-provider-20260521-verify-01.md
